evidence: M-O s.v. school types: elementary school, citing Plaut.

phrases.english: Next year you’ll go to school.
Today you’re going to school for the first time.

phrases.latin: nōluit in Flāvī lūdum mē mittere, magnī quō puerī magnīs ē centuriōnibus ortī, laevō suspēnsī loculōs tabulamque lacertō, ībant
phrases.english: (my father) would not send me to Flavius’s school, where the big boys, sons of big centurions, used to go with satchel and writing tablet slung on the left arm

sources: Lewis & Short: ludus
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 31.
